_about: Key poses of the clips: where the strike lands (contact_s) and the poses the move data snaps to. 30 fps, baked by retarget_ual.py from the free Quaternius clips (CC0). Use these seconds as clip_s in moves.json anim.keys.

idle.note: arms down, a little weight shift; the clipboard hangs in the left hand

run.note: a clerk's jog, not Red's sprint

talk.note: talking with small hand gestures; cutscene dialogue

gesture.note: UAL2 Yes: the left arm (the clipboard arm) comes up and points, then drops; plays once. Reads as 'you are out of compliance'

stagger.note: Hit_Chest slowed to 0.6x then the end pose held 2 s (the importer loops this name)

knockdown.note: the fall onto the floor; ends lying down and holds the pose

defeated.note: Death01; ends lying down and holds the pose (the end of the on-foot fight)
